item.title: Braid 0.0.15
item.description:
• Share for Review exports from Capture One in one go and uploads 4 images at a time.
  • Sharing keeps going on its own after Wi-Fi drops or the lid closes, and Resume continues where it stopped.
  • Cancel stops an upload right away.
  • Simpler Share window: open the session from it, and time left you can trust.
  • Log Out of your online galleries in Settings; shared galleries keep syncing.
  • Deleting an online gallery frees its space and still saves the client's last picks.
  • Gallery sync no longer asks for Keychain access in the background.
  • Braid spots a gallery helper running from an old copy and fixes it with one click.
  • The gallery viewer menu closes when you tap outside it on a phone.
